claims: Japan won the World Baseball Classic in 2006 by defeating Cuba 10-6.
Japan won the World Baseball Classic in 2009 by defeating South Korea 5-3.
Japan won the World Baseball Classic in 2023 by defeating USA 3-2.
Dominican Republic won the World Baseball Classic in 2013 by defeating Puerto Rico 3-0.
United States won the World Baseball Classic in 2017 by defeating Puerto Rico 8-0.
Venezuela won the World Baseball Classic in 2026 by defeating USA 3-2.
Venezuela secured its first World Baseball Classic championship in 2026.
Japan holds the most World Baseball Classic titles.
Japan is the only team to have won the World Baseball Classic more than once.
Japan has 3 World Baseball Classic titles.
The Dominican Republic in 2013 is the only team to win the World Baseball Classic undefeated.
Shohei Ohtani (Japan) was the 2023 World Baseball Classic MVP.
The 2021 World Baseball Classic tournament was delayed to 2023 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
